title: Design System: QT App V1 Bootstrap

title.purpose: Page-level title for the current dashboard surface.

body.purpose: Descriptions, table content, alert descriptions, and operator-facing status text.

label.purpose: Status tags, compact metadata, and small control labels.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Small hover or focus-within lift for interactive containers only.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus and touch-assist focus treatment.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Short product UI state transitions for hover, focus, and active changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Use for the current primary bootstrap action such as refreshing the snapshot.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 4px 15px; border: 1px solid #0078c8; border-radius: 6px; background: #0078c8; color: #ffffff; font: 400 14px/1.57 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1995e0; border-color: #1995e0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 120, 200, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #005b94; border-color: #005b94; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Use for secondary retry actions that should not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { height: 32px; padding: 4px 15px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #000000; font: 400 14px/1.57 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #0078c8; color: #0078c8; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 120, 200, 0.22); } .ds-btn-default:active { border-color: #005b94; color: #005b94; }

components.name: Status Card
components.description: Compact diagnostic container for one bootstrap status section.
components.html:
驱动服务状态成功
租约状态
Active
设备会话状态
Connected
components.css: .ds-status-card { width: 320px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #000000; font: 400 14px/1.57 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-status-card:hover { border-color: #b7dfff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12); } .ds-status-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-status-card dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr; gap: 4px 12px; margin: 0; } .ds-status-card dt { color: #595959; } .ds-status-card dd { margin: 0; } .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-status-tag-success { background: #52c41a; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Signal Snapshot Table
components.description: Read-only compact table for Driver Service signal snapshot values.
components.css: .ds-signal-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #ffffff; color: #000000; font: 400 14px/1.57 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-signal-table th { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d9; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; background: #fafafa; } .ds-signal-table td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; } .ds-signal-table tr:hover td { background: #e6f4ff; }

components.name: Error Alert
components.description: Operator-facing error block for mapped bootstrap and driver failures.
components.html:
启动流程异常

启动失败：请查看诊断日志后重试。
components.css: .ds-error-alert { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ffccc7; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff1f0; color: #5c0011; font: 400 14px/1.57 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-error-alert strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #a8071a; font-weight: 600; } .ds-error-alert p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Theme Segmented Control
components.description: Icon-style display preference control for light, dark, and system theme modes.
components.css: .ds-theme-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f0f0f0; font: 400 12px/1.5 IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-theme-segmented button { width: 28px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #000000; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-segmented button:hover { color: #0078c8; } .ds-theme-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #ffffff; color: #0078c8; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12); } .ds-theme-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 120, 200, 0.22); }

narrative.overview: `QT App V1 Bootstrap` 的视觉系统是一块现场控制台，而不是展示型 dashboard（仪表盘）。它服务于固定 1280x720 的 10-inch Windows touch IPC（10 寸 Windows 触控工控机）。系统需要有设计性，但必须克制，设计感来自清楚的 hierarchy（层级）、稳定的 alignment（对齐）、紧凑但可触控的 controls（控件）、明确的 state color（状态色）和中文文案。
keyCharacteristics: Fixed field viewport（固定现场视口）：以 1280x720 为设计基线。
Compact diagnostic layout（紧凑诊断布局）：信息密度高，但状态和动作必须可扫读。
Restrained industrial color（克制工业色）：沿用现有 #0078c8 主色和 Ant Design 状态色。
Light lift, not decoration（轻层级，不装饰）：层级可用轻阴影和边界表达，但不能变成展示型卡片墙。
Chinese-first operator copy（中文优先操作文案）：错误和状态不能回退到英文原始异常。

rules.name: The Status Means State Rule
rules.body: Control Blue、Signal Green、Caution Amber 和 Fault Red 只用于动作、选择和状态，不用于装饰。

rules.name: The No Spectacle Dark Rule
rules.body: dark theme（深色主题）必须保持现场可读，禁止做成过度炫酷 dark dashboard（深色仪表盘）。

rules.name: The One Operator Language Rule
rules.body: 用户可见状态、错误和动作必须优先使用中文；不要把 raw English runtime error（英文运行时错误）暴露给操作员。

rules.name: The Lift Must Explain Itself Rule
rules.body: 阴影必须表示可操作、当前、聚焦或临时浮层；静态装饰阴影禁止使用。

dos: Do keep the interface as a Field Control Desk（现场控制台）：紧凑、清晰、状态优先。
Do use #0078c8 as Control Blue for primary action（主操作）、current selection（当前选择）和 info state（信息状态）。
Do preserve the single Ant Design component vocabulary（组件语言）：Button、Card、Table、Alert、Tag、Segmented、Descriptions。
Do render user-facing UI（用户界面） and error copy（错误文案） in Chinese.
donts: Don't create traditional ERP-heavy form walls where every field has equal visual weight and operators must search for the current state.
Don't create over-styled dark dashboards that look impressive in screenshots but reduce trust, readability, or touch accuracy on field hardware.
Don't use low-contrast gray text, ambiguous status color, raw English runtime errors, or ordinary account/password login screens.
Don't suggest operators can manually override ip, port, or deviceId outside the signedLease（签名租约） and signalConfig（信号配置） path.
Don't use decorative cards, nested cards, broad shadows, gradient text, glass effects, or visual flourishes that do not help an operator answer the startup-state question faster.
